def dijkstra(graph, start, end):
    n = len(graph)
    # dist[i] = minimum time to reach stage i
    dist = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)

    # Priority queue: (time, stage)

            if new_time < dist[next_node]:
                dist[next_node] = new_time
                heapq.heappush(pq, (new_time, next_node))
